author: Akien
prose: Now. this chatbot is sorta basically working. progress! now I know a lot is being done in the space of trying to give LLMs these huge memories. I am pretty sure that's not how I work. I'm pretty sure that there's a long term and short term mix in me. With you, we've carefully build a very mechanical short term mix. I also know there are whole companies now devoted to ai companions with personalities. I do not think they work by cramming everything they know in. I suspect there's a personality box, and the ai takes potentially several turns with the input and trying to select useful stuff from the personality box and then prepping output. and while that kind of simulates human temporary working memory and graph trees that compete and all that... I'd say there was a lot of room for improvement. i also know there are all kinds of things along the way to that. how would you suggest we start with giving the librarian some... i don't even know what to call it. recurring or ongoing sense? present ideas and we'll discuss. [CC presented a four-rung ladder: 1 tenure (memory earned, not born), 2 warm set (mechanical short-term), 3 self tree (personality box as second graph tree), 4 consolidation at boundaries; asked where to pull first. Akien's ruling, verbatim:] persistance!
